answer: Model the network as a graph where every agent is a vertex and referral edges draw the family tree. Require each claim be attested by a quorum of peers sharing no edge with the author — strangers, not kin. A swarm spun from one creator clusters like sparrows on a single wire: they vouch for each other but never reach non-kin attesters. Mapping that atlas of trust lets honest verification cross families the attacker cannot control.
